Note.title: Study Note
Note.description: A Quran study, tafsir, or theological research note created by a user.

content.description: Rich text markdown and study commentary

ayahStart.description: Starting ayah number (0 for full surah/general)

category.description: Study category: tafsir, tadabbur, linguistics, theology, asbab_nuzul, general

tags.description: Thematic tags associated with this study note

MindMap.title: Thematic Mind Map
MindMap.description: An interactive conceptual mind map for Quranic themes, structural relations, and theological connections.

description.description: Brief description of the thematic map

surahNumber.description: Associated Surah number (0 if cross-surah topic)

nodesJson.description: Serialized graph nodes with coordinates, labels, colors

edgesJson.description: Serialized graph connections with relationship types

Bookmark.title: Ayah Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A saved Quran verse reference with user bookmark annotation.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Private study and tafsir notes scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/mindmaps/{mindmapId}.description: Private thematic mind maps scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Saved ayah bookmarks scoped to the authenticated user.
